app.tagline: An orchestra for your AI coding agents
app.mode: Demo, or your live Claude Code sessions

start.note: Sound on. Demo mode: five simulated agents, nothing is connected yet.
start.privacy: Bytehoven never calls a model. It only listens.
start.liveNote: Sound on. Live mode: your running Claude Code sessions take the stage. Only tool names and file names are read.

top.popout: Pop out: an always-on-top mini window

fermata.hint: Enter to approve · Esc to deny

detail.demoNote: Demo mode: the score is handed over on stage, but no agent is run.
detail.liveNote: Runs claude -p in this session's folder. Reading, searching and editing files are allowed; other tools follow your Claude Code permission settings, and anything that asks for permission becomes a fermata here. rm, git push and curl are always blocked.
detail.taskSent: Part handed over. Watch the second chair.
detail.taskBusy: Another part is still playing. Try again when it finishes.
detail.taskFailed: Couldn't start the part. Is the claude command installed?

welcome.title: Welcome to the concert
welcome.body: Every AI coding agent is a musician on this stage. Whatever it does becomes music, so you can follow your agents just by listening.

ines.title: Ines · violin
ines.body: Ines does research: web searches and docs. Each tool call is a short motif. If she calls in a helper, a second violin walks on stage.

mira.title: Mira · flute
mira.body: Mira writes the documentation. When an agent reads a file, its musician turns a page on the stand and plays a soft note.

clara.title: Clara · piano
clara.body: Clara writes code. Every file she edits lands as a chord. Between steps she thinks, and a thinking musician quietly tunes up.

bruno.title: Bruno · double bass
bruno.body: Bruno runs commands and builds. Shell commands sound like a rhythmic pulse. When there is nothing to do, a musician dozes off. Zzz.

otto.title: Otto · timpani
otto.body: Otto runs the tests. Green tests end in a cadence like this one. A failure is a sour chord and red sparks.

conductor.title: You are the conductor
conductor.body: Click any musician to see what they're doing, change their volume or hand them a new part. The baton points at whoever you pick.

score.title: The live score
score.body: Everything you hear is written down here, one line per musician. A long golden note means someone is waiting for you.

fermata.title: The fermata
fermata.body: When an agent needs your permission, its musician raises a hand and the music holds one chord. The tension keeps rising until you answer: Enter approves, Esc denies.

feed.title: The programme
feed.body: The same story in words: which tool, which file. Never your prompts, never your code.

end.title: Enjoy the concert
end.body: Turn the sound up a little and let your agents play. You can replay this tour any time from the top bar.

signals.title: Learn the signals
signals.body: Tap a signal to hear it. Every musician plays it in their own voice, but the meaning is always the same.

pip.away: The concert is playing in the mini window.

live.empty: No Claude Code session is running. Start one and the band starts playing.
live.unavailable: Live mode needs the dev server: run npm run dev.

file_read.name: Reading a file
file_read.desc: a page turns, one soft note

subagent_join.name: A sub-agent joins
subagent_join.desc: a harp sweep, a second chair walks on

task_done.name: Finished a part
task_done.desc: a short finale and a bow

permission_request.name: Needs you
permission_request.desc: the music holds one chord, tension rises
